---
title: Match facility names across public lists
---

## Question

How can two public facility lists be aligned when names, abbreviations, and address formats differ?

## Data

Two openly available CMS hospital files cached under `data-raw/` and reused by `R/app-04-facility-names.R`.

## Linkage strategy

Standardise facility names and address fields, block on state, and use string distance plus postcode agreement for candidate scoring.

## Result

The example shows where deterministic exact-name matching breaks down on abbreviations and campus variants.

## Reporting

List the source URLs, cache date, normalisation rules, and any unresolved many-to-one name collisions.
